Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Location, Location, Location]]: the cover of Luigi Salvaneschi's ''Location, Location, Location: How to Select the Best Site for Your Business'' (Grants Pass, Oregon: Oasis Press/PSI Research, 1996; ISBN 1-55571-376-9; Library of Congress 96032255), published the year before the [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] set.

Source: cover image 775269 at Open Library, the Internet Archive's book catalogue (362 by 475 pixels; SHA-256 d5e4aa678ad70f502e294e2fe24ccecde6edd172a6fc7c4bdec1021debb2dde9). The book itself: [https://archive.org/details/locationlocation00salv Internet Archive item locationlocation00salv] (1996).

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a low-resolution copy (362 by 475 pixels) of a 1996 book cover, © its publisher, shown to identify the book whose title is the phrase the card's title uses. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
